decisionRule: Predictive-screen signal requires negative upper interval bounds for holdout reward MSE of online minus actionErased AND online minus last-reward persistence in BOTH environments. This does not qualify a policy. No parameter search or sample extension.
interpretation: Each founder owns its own action-conditioned model, trained only on its actual completed consecutive observation/action/reward transitions. Next-observation targets are residuals from the current observation. Query predictions before updating from that transition; evaluate the chronological second half. The historical controller generates the trajectory unchanged. Rewards are actual own net energy increments, not counterfactual/oracle labels. Targets are stored separately from predictor inputs. Action-erased models share shape/rate; freeze/reset controls isolate acquisition history. Plans are learned fixed-action open-loop forecasts and never affect worlds or train the model. Historical seeds are reused exploratory data, not untouched policy qualification. No model metabolic price or world checkpoint integration is claimed.
